# Open Defender

> Open Defender is an open-source endpoint detection and response (EDR) agent for Linux servers. It provides SSH, web application, and database protection, eBPF monitoring, and resource alerts.

## Documentation

- [Documentation (English)](https://open-defender.github.io/docs.html): Installation, service management, monitoring configuration, event export, and CLI commands.
- [Documentation (Russian)](https://open-defender.github.io/ru/docs.html): Installation, service management, monitoring configuration, event export, and CLI commands.
- [Documentation (Simplified Chinese)](https://open-defender.github.io/zh-cn/docs.html): Installation, service management, monitoring configuration, event export, and CLI commands.

## Project overview

- [Open Defender (English)](https://open-defender.github.io/): Features, response modes, and options for running locally or connecting a dashboard.
- [Open Defender (Russian)](https://open-defender.github.io/ru/): Features, response modes, and options for running locally or connecting a dashboard.
- [Open Defender (Simplified Chinese)](https://open-defender.github.io/zh-cn/): Features, response modes, and options for running locally or connecting a dashboard.
